headline: Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan discuss modernization of border crossing points
summary: Kyrgyz Foreign Minister Zheenbek Kulubaev received Kazakhstan's ambassador Abylkair Skakov to discuss modernising border crossing points between the two countries.
why: Border crossing efficiency affects cargo flows and trade costs between Central Asian economies, shaping the logistics sector.
original_headline: Модернизацию пунктов пропуска на границе обсудили Кыргызстан и Казахстан
